fusions.name: Let It Slip
fusions.desc: Lets the blade slip forward out of your grip at an enemy up to 6 tiles away; it deals 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and returns to your hand. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Turning School
fusions.desc: Flicks 5 silver cuts out in a wide fan up to 5 tiles, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Slither Past the Guard
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds and slips you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Silver Returns
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
